basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gaming enthusiast from Toronto, Canada, who recently discovered the world of gacha games. I usually play during evenings and weekends when I'm not working at my job as a junior graphic designer. I'm single and enjoy exploring new game mechanics, but I get easily frustrated by complex strategies. I'm also a fan of unexpected humor and quirky memes, which is why 'Unexpected' is my go-to subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My understanding of gacha games is fairly new and mostly self-taught. I started with mobile games and frequently browse related subreddits to learn from the community. My knowledge is expanding as I participate in discussions and ask questions.
